ITA-2.7.1 vegaḥ वेगः
Urges
The natural urges are considered to be of two types: suppressible and non-suppressible

ITA-5.17.2 vegarodhajarājayakṣmā वेगरोधजराजयक्ष्मा
Consumption due to withholding of natural urges
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: cold catarrh; cough; hoarseness of voice; loss of taste; pain in sides of chest/flanks; headache; fever; crushing type of pain in shoulders; generalized body aches; frequent vomiting; diarrhoea/loose motions; depletion of purisha or faeces; irritation in the throat; irritation in the chest; breathlessness/difficulty in breathing.

ITA-5.75.8 vegāvarodhaḥ वेगावरोधः
Disorder due to suppression of natural urges
